newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania Rokishkis '96 profit 12.19 mln litas.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania Rokishkis '96 profit 12.19 mln litas.

text.p: Leading Lithuanian cheese maker Rokishkis, quoted on the main list of the stock exchange, on Tuesday said its net profit in 1996 grew to 12.19 million litas from 9.32 million litas in 1995.

The company said in a statement of unaudited results that its gross profit was 20.19 million litas and the operating profit was 14.67 million litas. It did not give any comparisons for figures other than the net profit.
Rokishkis is considered one of the blue chip stocks on the market and investment house Williams de Broe recently bought a 14 percent stake in it.
Rokishkis said that sales and services reached over 137.05 million litas and its assets at the end of 1996 were worth 82.02 million litas.
